title: Once Again From Here / Bathroom War / Tick-Tock, Tick-Tock, the Sound of Love
overview: When Lala and Rito are running late for school, they'll realize that using a teleportation device get to school faster can have some visible consequences.

title: The Thing That Surfaces in the Darkness / Welcome to the Yuuki Household / Slumber Party
overview: As Rito attempts to keep Haruna away from Lala’s gadgets, they accidentally activate one and are warped to another location -with no clothes!

title: Special Love Potion / Looking at You Through the Lens... / The Lovely You is Cinderella
overview: Rito delivers assignments to a sick Yuki who panics when a boy is in her room. Later, Rito tries on Lala's glasses and discovers a surprising trick with them.

title: Yami Yami Fashion / Wonderful Love / Twins Escape
overview: Since Yami always wears the same clothing, Risa and Mio take her shopping. However, her new and improved wardrobe prevents her from using her weapons properly.

title: Queen of Romance?! / Let's Play a Game / That Sweet Feeling Tastes Like Chocolate
overview: Rito avoids Lala while Saki daydreams of Zastin. Everyone prepares for Valentine’s Day, and Rito is the object of desire for many.

title: Beach Girls / Late Night Private Tutor / Master of Romance
overview: Things go awry when the group visits Saki’s private beach. Lala helps Rito study for an upcoming math test.

title: Yami's Clinic / Hostility / A Weird Haruna
overview: Yami falls ill with a fever, and Rito rushes her to the hospital. As she recovers, Yami questions why Rito would help her.

title: Become Bigger / Wonderful Life / The Trance of Feelings
overview: Haruna feels self-conscious about the size of her bust, and later finds a stray dog! Mikan and Yami switch bodies to experience each other’s abilities.

title: For Whom the Bell Tolls / The Troubling Rampage / Loving Idol
overview: Mikan and Rito’s parents are never home, so the approaching Christmas holiday doesn't excite them, but Lala still helps fulfill one of Mikan's wishes.

title: Pollen Telepathy / A Girl's Feelings / Heart-Throbbing E-Mail
overview: Celine is drunk and spreads her pollen, making Saki and the others fall for Rito. Later, a misunderstanding by Momo sparks an interesting turn of events.

title: All Quiet on the 'Sister' Front / The False Love? / Predicting Love
overview: Momo sneaks into Rito’s bed. Mikan, who wants to catch Momo in the act, sneaks in instead! Meanwhile, Celine is drunkely polinating and this time, Yami is under fire.

title: I Love You Parts 1, 2 & 3
overview: An outing goes horribly wrong, and Rito comes to an incredible realization, with a more incredible dilemma around it.
